start_frame: The sh069 set-up, tighter: her mouth and jaw filling more of the frame as she snaps the order at herself.
end_frame: The same frame a moment later: the order plainly disobeyed — she is crying harder, and nothing in the camera has acknowledged either the command or the failure.
constraint_honoured: 'Held just long enough for the order and the failure to obey it — the comedy and the distress are the same shot.'
movement_note: A tighter static frame rather than a push in: the episode has no push-ins, and the cut is what tightens.
